title: Email/query: O(N) per-article CID lookup makes full-group scan O(N^2)
description: server.rs Email/query arm makes one lookup_cid() DB call per overview record. For a group with N articles this is O(N) sequential SQLite queries before any filtering or pagination. Fix: batch lookup via an IN-clause or a range API. Expected impact: severe above ~10k articles/group.
